entities.name: Sandomierz–Silesian Offensive
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Sandomierz–Silesian offensive was part of the Soviet Vistula–Oder offensive during World War II. It was carried out by the 1st Ukrainian Front under Ivan Konev, aiming to destroy German troops in southern Poland, reach the Oder and capture a bridgehead on the west bank of the Oder.
